/*
  Gentle instrumental fallback used when the music file is missing or cannot be
  played. It is generated with the Web Audio API, so it never needs a file.
  A slow eight-bar chord progression in D major (D - A - Bm - F#m - G - D - G - A).
*/const PROGRESSION=[[293.66,369.99,440.0],// D
[277.18,329.63,440.0],// A
[246.94,293.66,369.99],// Bm
[185.0,220.0,277.18],// F#m
[246.94,293.66,392.0],// G
[293.66,369.99,440.0],// D
[246.94,293.66,392.0],// G
[277.18,329.63,440.0]// A
];const BAR_SECONDS=3.2;export function startPad(){const AudioCtx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AudioCtx)return null;let ctx;try{ctx=new AudioCtx();}catch(err){return null;}const master=ctx.createGain();master.gain.value=0.0001;master.connect(ctx.destination);master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16,ctx.currentTime+3);const filter=ctx.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=1800;filter.connect(master);let bar=0;let stopped=false;const playBar=()=>{if(stopped)return;const start=ctx.currentTime+0.12;const chord=PROGRESSION[bar%PROGRESSION.length];bar+=1;chord.forEach((freq,index)=>{const osc=ctx.createOscillator();osc.type=index===0?'sine':'triangle';osc.frequency.value=freq;osc.detune.value=(index-1)*4;const gain=ctx.createGain();gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,start);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16/(index+1.4),start+BAR_SECONDS*0.35);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,start+BAR_SECONDS*1.02);osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(filter);osc.start(start);osc.stop(start+BAR_SECONDS*1.1);});// Soft bass note underneath the chord.
const bass=ctx.createOscillator();bass.type='sine';bass.frequency.value=chord[0]/2;const bassGain=ctx.createGain();bassGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,start);bassGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18,start+0.7);bassGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,start+BAR_SECONDS*1.05);bass.connect(bassGain);bassGain.connect(filter);bass.start(start);bass.stop(start+BAR_SECONDS*1.1);};playBar();const timer=setInterval(playBar,BAR_SECONDS*1000);return{stop(){stopped=true;clearInterval(timer);const now=ctx.currentTime;master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);master.gain.setValueAtTime(master.gain.value||0.0001,now);master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,now+0.6);setTimeout(()=>{if(ctx.state!=='closed')ctx.close();},900);}};}
